meta.title: A Procol user of ANOTHER company is treated as outside
gaps: Log in to Asha's mailbox, open the Procol approval request, use Consult, address a user from another Procol company, send without changing the subject, wait for processing, and verify the 'is not part of your organisation on Procol' bounce-back and that the external user receives nothing
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Log in to Asha's mailbox, open the Procol approval request, use Consult, address a user from another Procol company, send without changing the subject, wait for processing, and verify the 'is not part of your organisation on Procol' bounce-back and that the external user receives nothing

args.need: log in as Asha, open the Procol approval request email, use Consult to email the named user from another Procol company without changing the subject, send it, wait 1-2 minutes, and verify the organisation-membership bounce-back and that the external user receives nothing

steps.note: The catalog cannot access mailboxes, send consult emails, wait for mailbox processing, or verify bounce-back delivery.

args.text: is not part of your organisation on Procol

steps.note: Closest available assertion for the expected bounce-back text if the tester leaves the resulting email view visible.
